create.name: Vince Sauter
create.bio:
Vince Sauter first studied qigong and tai chi in local community classes in 1997, and it became a lifelong path. He is now a Senior Trainer with the Institute of Integral Qigong and Tai Chi, where he teaches Dr. Roger Jahnke's gentle "Tai Chi Easy" as a foundation that almost anyone can learn. He has also studied with Robert Peng, and with Michael Reed Gach, founder of the Acupressure Institute, to deepen his understanding of the meridians. He is certified in rehabilitative qigong and tai chi, Shibashi, and White Tiger's Five Element Qigong.

He has been on the faculty of the Omega Institute in Rhinebeck, New York since 2014, and has a silk-reeling workshop there scheduled for 2027. Through Clear Stream Tai Chi he teaches a weekly class on Zoom and in-person series at his local library in the Hudson Valley. He also leads practice-leader trainings for the Healer Within Foundation. In 2018 he published "Everyday All Day," a guide to weaving qigong into ordinary life, and his teaching keeps that focus on practice that fits everyday routines.
